findings.location: Throughout article (Scripture quotations and inline references)
findings.source_quote:
For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it –Matthew 16:25.

If ye love me, keep my commandments –John 14:15. And, He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him –1 John 2:4.

By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another –John 13:35.

Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter. Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you –James 5:5-6.

And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection –Luke 8:14.

This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come... lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God; ... from such turn away –2 Timothy 3:1-5.

I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot... I will spue thee out of my mouth –Revelation 3:15-16.

Remember a little leaven leavens the lump. (1 Corinthians 5)

– Ephesians 4:11-13.
findings.suggested_fix:
Translate or localize the English book names into conventional Indonesian forms while preserving chapter and verse numbers and surrounding punctuation/placement. Replace each English book name with its Indonesian equivalent in the quoted text exactly where it appears. Suggested mappings:
- Matthew -> Matius
- John -> Yohanes
- 1 John -> 1 Yohanes
- James -> Yakobus
- Luke -> Lukas
- 2 Timothy -> 2 Timotius
- Revelation -> Wahyu
- 1 Corinthians -> 1 Korintus
- Ephesians -> Efesus

Apply these replacements so the verses read, for example: “... –Matius 16:25.”; “... –Yohanes 14:15.”; “... –1 Yohanes 2:4.”; etc. Ensure the punctuation, spacing, and dash before the reference remain as in the source.
findings.translation_quote:
Sebab barangsiapa mau menyelamatkan nyawanya, ia akan kehilangan itu; tetapi barangsiapa kehilangan nyawanya karena Aku, ia akan memperolehnya –Matthew 16:25.

Jikalau kamu mengasihi Aku, kamu akan menuruti segala perintah-Ku –John 14:15. Dan barangsiapa berkata: Aku mengenal Dia, tetapi ia tidak menuruti perintah-Nya, ia adalah pendusta, dan kebenaran tidak ada di dalam dia –1 John 2:4.

Dari adanya kasih itu semua orang akan tahu, bahwa kamu adalah murid-murid-Ku: yaitu jikalau kamu saling mengasihi –John 13:35.

Kamu hidup dalam kesenangan di bumi, dan bermewah-mewah... –James 5:5-6.

...dan tercekik oleh kekhawatiran dan kekayaan dan kesenangan hidup ini... –Luke 8:14.

...pada hari-hari terakhir akan datang masa-masa sukar... pencinta kesenangan lebih dari pencinta Allah... dari mereka jauhilah –2 Timothy 3:1-5.

Aku tahu segala pekerjaanmu—engkau tidak dingin dan tidak panas... Aku akan memuntahkan engkau dari mulut-Ku –Revelation 3:15-16.

Ingat sejumput ragi menggurihkan seluruh adonan. (1 Corinthians 5)

...sampai ukuran kepenuhan Kristus – Ephesians 4:11-13.
